# swap — commands

<!-- generated by tools/gen-docs.mjs from upstream onchainos 4.6.3; do not edit -->
DEX swap. Required flags are in the signature; `ocl swap <cmd> --help` prints the full upstream help.

### swap quote
Get swap quote (read-only price estimate)
`ocl swap quote --from <FROM> --to <TO> --chain <CHAIN> [options]`
- `--amount <AMOUNT>` — Amount in minimal units (wei/lamports)
- `--readable-amount <READABLE_AMOUNT>` — Human-readable amount (e.g. "1.5" for 1.5 USDC)
- `--swap-mode <SWAP_MODE>` — Swap mode: exactIn or exactOut (default exactIn)

### swap swap
Get swap transaction data (quote → sign → broadcast)
`ocl swap swap --from <FROM> --to <TO> --chain <CHAIN> --wallet <WALLET> [options]`
- `--amount <AMOUNT>` — Amount in minimal units
- `--readable-amount <READABLE_AMOUNT>` — Human-readable amount (e.g. "1.5" for 1.5 USDC)
- `--slippage <SLIPPAGE>` — Slippage tolerance in percent (e.g. "1" for 1%)
- `--gas-level <GAS_LEVEL>` — Gas priority: slow, average, fast (default: average) (default average)
- `--swap-mode <SWAP_MODE>` — Swap mode: exactIn or exactOut (default exactIn)
- `--tips <TIPS>` — Jito tips in SOL for Solana MEV protection (range: 0.0000000001–2)
- `--max-auto-slippage <MAX_AUTO_SLIPPAGE>` — Max auto slippage percent cap when autoSlippage is enabled (e.g. "0.5" for 0.5%)

### swap approve
Get ERC-20 approval transaction data
`ocl swap approve --token <TOKEN> --amount <AMOUNT> --chain <CHAIN>`

### swap check-approvals
Check ERC-20 token approval allowance
`ocl swap check-approvals --chain <CHAIN> --address <ADDRESS> --token <TOKEN> [options]`
- `--spender <SPENDER>` — Spender address (optional, defaults to OKX DEX router)

### swap chains
Get supported chains for DEX aggregator
`ocl swap chains`

### swap liquidity
Get available liquidity sources on a chain
`ocl swap liquidity --chain <CHAIN>`

### swap execute
One-shot swap: quote → approve (if needed) → swap → sign & broadcast → txHash
`ocl swap execute --from <FROM> --to <TO> --chain <CHAIN> --wallet <WALLET> [options]`
- `--amount <AMOUNT>` — Amount in minimal units (wei/lamports)
- `--readable-amount <READABLE_AMOUNT>` — Human-readable amount (e.g. "1.5" for 1.5 USDC)
- `--slippage <SLIPPAGE>` — Slippage tolerance in percent
- `--gas-level <GAS_LEVEL>` — Gas priority: slow, average, fast (default average)
- `--swap-mode <SWAP_MODE>` — Swap mode: exactIn or exactOut (default exactIn)
- `--tips <TIPS>` — Jito tips in SOL for Solana MEV protection (range: 0.0000000001–2)
- `--max-auto-slippage <MAX_AUTO_SLIPPAGE>` — Max auto slippage percent cap
- `--mev-protection` — Enable MEV protection
- `--gas-token-address <GAS_TOKEN_ADDRESS>` — Gas token contract address for Gas Station payment (from tokenList)
- `--relayer-id <RELAYER_ID>` — Relayer ID for Gas Station (from tokenList)
- `--enable-gas-station` — Enable Gas Station first-time activation or re-enable
- `--force` — Force execution: skip backend risk warning 81362 (skipWarning=true on broadcast)
- `--notify-job-id <NOTIFY_JOB_ID>` — Auto copy-trade context (set by autotrade execution cards, not for manual use): when present, the CLI itself pushes the outcome notification — success tx/ord…
